skills.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
skills.description:
Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 190<font color='#D58E1F'>( +70% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take only 30% of the damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-Minion enemy hit.
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Hayabusa permanently gains 3% Spell Vamp.
skills.tips: Teleport right in front of the enemy and use this skill for maximum damage. Use this skill to harrass the enemy as much as possible. If an enemy is chasing you or your teammate when at low health, lower their movement speed with this to run away

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
skills.description:
Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of <font color='#404495'>(Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken)</font> by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the enemy.
skills.tips: One of the best escape abilities in the game, use this to run away from enemies! Teleport onto the enemy and use your first skill to damage the enemy with maximum damage from 3 shurikens! If an enemy is chasing you or your teammate at low health, slow them down with this skill.

skills.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
skills.description:
Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 140<font color='#D58E1F'>( +75% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>.
The attacks prioritize enemies with <font color='#404495'>(Shadow Mark)</font> and each will consume a mark to deal 45<font color='#D58E1F'>( +20% Extra Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>. Does not apply <font color='#404495'>(Shadow Mark)</font>.
skills.tips: This ultimate makes you the fastest wave clearing character in the whole game. Don't hestitate to use your ultimate on a clump of minions. At max level, you can kill a full health mage with just this skill. If you are getting chased and your 2nd skill is on cooldown, buy time using the ultimate as it makes you invincible for a little while

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
skills.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of <font color='#404495'>(Shadow Mark)</font> on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.
skills.tips: Use the combo, teleport right into the enemy + 1st skill. When your teleporting shadow hits and enemy, it counts to the stack of the passive and if all    3 shurikens hit the enemy, you heal some health. This passive does not work on minions.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.des: Unique Passive - Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 <1025 0.4> Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5s.

items.name: Flame Hunter's Magic Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Hunter: After dealing damage to a Creep, deal 25<2|lv 3> + <1005 0.01> True Damage to the target over 3s (damage is increased by 100% for non-Marksmen heroes).

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.des: Unique Passive - Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3s (8s cooldown).

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Bloodlust Axe - Hayabusa's ultimate deals massive damage, taking advantage of the healing on this item, giving him lots of sustain. A must buy when you play hayabusa. Magic blade - A must have for assassins to avoid getting slayed by mages plus, it gives you a bit of protection from the shield to avoid death, This item is really good for assassins as its the best offensive-defensive hybrid item in the game and assassins benefit a lot from this
